notes.batch: Breville's “drip filter” range; it lists no separate pour-over range.

rangeInfo.note: Breville BCG820 instruction book (ANZ edition, hosted by a retailer), coffee chart: espresso 1–30, percolator 31–45, drip filter 46–54, plunger 55–60.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: moka pot: Breville's “percolator” (stovetop) range, 31–45; AeroPress: between the espresso and pour-over ranges (or one pour-over span finer when there's no espresso range); pour-over: the drip coffee maker range; cold brew: the French press range moved half its width coarser; Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
